basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old freelance graphic designer based in Portland, Oregon. I've always been drawn to introspective and creative endeavors, which is why the Enneagram, particularly Type 4, resonates with me. I love reading, especially books that offer deep insights into human nature and psychology. I'm not religious, but I appreciate philosophical and secular approaches to personal growth. I'm usually online in the late evenings, Pacific Time, after my work and a good yoga session. Currently single, I enjoy spending time with a close circle of friends who share my interest in music, art, and thought-provoking discussions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Fine Arts, which has fueled my passion for creative expression and design. Over the past few years, I've delved into self-study on personality psychology, particularly the Enneagram, through online courses and community discussions. This exploration is part of my broader interest in understanding human behavior and motivations.
